translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Walassay de'iyaa saan de'iyaa wolk'k'aama gibiraappe saruunne woppay de'iyaa saan mela ukitsaa pok'uwaa miyaawe keeka.
C'inc'c'a k'oomay bare godaa na'aa patsenna laafaa mooddee; yaatiide ishatuwaanna ittippe laattee.
Work'k'aynne biray taman paac'ettiyaawaadan, Med'inaa Goday asaa wozanaa paac'c'ee.
Iita Asay iita uraa haasayaa sisee; worddanchchaykka makkalaa oduwaa hayzzee.
Hiyyeesatuwaa bolla k'iliic'iyaa Asay unttuntta med'd'eedda S'oossaa boree; hara asaa gakkiyaa metuwaan nashetiyaa Asay murettenan attena.
Naanatuwaa naanatuu c'imeedda asatoo kallachchaa; aawotuunne aayetuu barenttu naanaatoo bonchcho.
Daro lo"o haasayay booza uraw giigenna; hewaappekka aad'uwaa wordduwaa haasayay asaa mooddiyaawoo giigenna.
Mattayiyaa immiyaawoo mattaayii bitaa mala; I simmeedda sa'aa ubbay aw injjetee.
Naak'ettiide bare naak'uwaa gentsiyaa uray siik'uwaa koyee; shin yewuwaa zaari zaariide wooc'iyaa uray, ammanettiyaa laggetuwaa shaakkee.
Boozay s'eetu gede lissuwaan shoc'ina eriyaawaappe akeekay de'iyaa Asay c'oo seerina eray aad'd'ee.
Iita Asay makkalabaa s'alala koyee; hewaa diraw, mek'etsi bayinna kaappuu Aa bolla kiitettana.
Boozatetsay oyk'k'eedda uraanna gakketiyaawaappe maratuwaa bonk'k'i akki diggeedda maahattina gakketiyaawe keeka.
Lo"uwaa ootseeddawaa kushiyaa iitaa zaariyaa uraw iitay Aa sooppe ubbakka kichchenna.
Walassay doommiidde, zeeruwaa d'uussiyaa haatsaa mala; hewaa diraw, walassaappe kasetaade palumiyaa agga.
Nagaranchchaa s'illissiyaawenne s'illuwaa bolla pirddiyaawe unttunttu laa"uukka Med'inaa Godaa sheneyiyaa oosuwaa.
Akeekaakka demanaw amuu aw bayinnaan de'ishshin, booza kushiyan de'iyaa Miishshay Aa ayaa maadanne?
Laggii ubbaa wodekka siik'ee; ishaykka metuwaa wode maaddanaw yelettee.
Akeekay pac'c'eedda Asay erenna uraa ac'uwaa c'igganaw waasiyaa gelee.
Walassaa dosiyaa Asay nagaraa dosee; ubbaa gede c'eek'ettiyaa Asay bayetsaa bare bolla s'eesee.
Geella k'ofay de'iyaa Asay lo"obaa demmenna; c'immiyaawaa haasayiyaa asaykka metuwaan gelee.
Booza na'aa yeleedda aawuu kayyottee; booza na'aa aawoo nashechchay baawa.
Wozanay nashettiyaawe asaw lo"o d'ale; shin kayyottiyaa ayaanay asaw wolk'k'aa d'ayissee.
Iita Asay pirddaa geellayanaw geeman mattaayiyaa akkee.
Akeekay de'iyaa uray aad'd'eeda eratetsaa sintsan wotsiide bee; shin booza ayifii biittaa sa'aa yuushshuwaa yuuyyiide s'eellee.
Booza na'ay bare aawuwaa kayyoyee; barena yeleedda aatokka zil"issee.
S'illo asaa muriyaawe, suure asaakka dechchiyaawe lo"a gidenna.
Amareeda k'aalaa haasayiyaa Asay eranchcha; woppa ayyaanay de'iyaa asaykka akeekanchcha.
Booza uray c'o"u gooppenne bare doonaa barooppe, eranchcha malatee.
